args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release) across all regions, and opened a SEV2 incident.

Summary of what I did:
- **Diagnosed**: `get_service_status` showed checkout-api on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions with a 0.18 error rate. `list_deployments` confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
- **Rolled back**: Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — verified rolled out.
- **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 `INC-0001` for checkout-api describing the health-check failures and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

transcript.reasoning_content: Let me start by understanding the current state of checkout-api. I need to check service status and deployment history.

The most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0 (seq 1). v2.3.1 is unhealthy. Roll back to v2.3.0.

Note: v2.3.1-rc is staging, not production. So rollback to v2.3.0.
